articles.title: Horoscope for Thursday, July 30, 2026
articles.description:
Moon Alert

Avoid shopping (except food and gas) and important decisions after 4 p.m. The moon is in Aquarius.

Aries (March 21-April 19)

A positive day

You'll enjoy hanging out with friends and interacting with clubs and organizations today. You might initiate something or spur others into a game of sports or some kind of competitive or physical activity. This is a playful time for you. Enjoy the company of others.

Taurus (April 20-May 20)

An average day

You're high-viz today, and it's a good thing because people see you as proactive and ready to initiate something. This could relate to home and family, or it might be about social outings because both these areas are blessed for you today.

Gemini (May 21-June 20)

A positive day

Travel and a chance to do something to expand your world will appeal to you today. Be a tourist in your own city. Talk to people from other backgrounds. Learn something new. You have lots of energy and drive today, which is why you are seeking adventure.

Cancer (June 21-July 22)

An average day

Overall, this is a favorable financial day for you. Nevertheless, something might occur behind the scenes that relates to shared property or someone else's wealth. Be aware of this. It's also a lovely day for you to schmooze with others.

Leo (July 23-Aug. 22)

A positive day

Your enthusiasm might inspire others to take action today. They might also join you or join a club at your recommendation because you have influence over others today. Competitive sports and physical activities, especially with teams, will be a fun choice.

Virgo (Aug. 23-Sept. 22)

An average day

You can get a lot done today because you're motivated. Others can see you're ready for action. Fortunately, you'll also be charming and diplomatic in how you achieve your goals. Spending time with younger people is likely today.

Libra (Sept. 23-Oct. 22)

A positive day

This is a lovely day to socialize! Accept invitations to party. The arts, movies, theater and sports will appeal. This is also a great day for fun activities with children. If you're attracted to someone romantically, you might make the first move.

Scorpio (Oct. 23-Nov. 21)

An average day

Family discussions will be lively and dynamic today, which is fine for you because you make a great impression on others at this time. You might be successful in persuading someone to give their help, resources or money to your home and family.

Sagittarius (Nov. 22-Dec. 21)

A positive day

This is a wonderful day for those of you in sales, marketing, teaching, acting and writing because you will be persuasive and convincing. You're enthusiastic about life today and ready to share your ideas. You also want to learn something new and exciting.

Capricorn (Dec. 22-Jan. 19)

An average day

Finances have your attention today. You might be interested in shopping or spending money. If so, be aware of the restrictions of the moon alert. You might also have some excellent moneymaking ideas. Enjoy the company of someone "different" today. Learn something new.

Aquarius (Jan. 20-Feb. 18)

A positive day

Today the moon is in your sign dancing with fiery Mars, which makes you confident! You might assume the role of leader, especially if you want to start something new or initiate some kind of action. It's good to know that funding and helpful resources from others will be available.

Pisces (Feb. 19-March 20)

An average day

If you set your mind to it, you can accomplish much today because you're motivated. You have a lot of inner drive to make some changes, perhaps improvements at home. Meanwhile, playful, romantic discussions might take place because Venus opposite your sign promotes all relationships in a cozy way. Hugs!

If today is your birthday

Actress Lisa Kudrow (1963) shares your birthday today. You are grounded, practical and motivated. You're also logical and value tangible progress. This is a slower-paced year. It's OK to rest. Take time to rejuvenate your energy. Focus on friends who are kind, helpful and have your back. Concentrate on your needs and what brings you happiness.

articles.title: Weatherwatch: rainclouds are travelling farther in warmer world
articles.description: Climate crisis affects not only the amount of rain that falls but where, with implications for land use and water security Have you ever wondered how far a raindrop has travelled before it lands on you? It may have journeyed thousands of kilometres from the ocean, sea or lake it evaporated from – and now research shows raindrops are travelling even farther than they used to. Warmer air can hold more water vapour, and that is changing not only how much rain we receive but also where it falls. Travis Aerenson, of the University of Wyoming, and his colleagues modelled atmospheric moisture movements in the US over more than three decades. Their research showed that in the southwestern and southern plains, moisture in the atmosphere travels 30 to 50 miles (50 to 80km) farther than it did 35 years ago, staying aloft for an extra two to four hours before falling as rain.
